notes:
• Scheduled-ride request on the driver and scheduled rides on the passenger: the driver's request pop-up keeps Decline and Accept on screen in Malayalam and at a large font — the "Requested you" / "New time" pill moves under the passenger line so the title has the full width instead of wrapping a syllable per line, and the details scroll with the buttons pinned below; the pop-up and its ringing notification no longer stay up after the passenger cancels — the cancel now tells every driver the request reached (including nearby drivers with no bid, from the SCHEDULED_REQUESTED event, less decliners) with ride:scheduled_cancelled and a direct ride:cancelled, and the app closes the pop-up and cancels its INSISTENT notification on accept, decline, Back/View, cancel, a closed request or a refresh that no longer lists it; passenger My Rides is read again whenever the tab comes back into view and its Scheduled tab (app and API) lists every booking for later that has not completed, been cancelled or expired; the "Coming soon" service badge shrinks to fit at a large font; Android and iOS. scheduled-cancel and passenger-rides-list specs (API rides 156 tests), ScheduledRequestCloseTest, RideFilterTest; driver 122 / passenger 66 unit tests. Found on Phone A + B; fix not yet checked on phones; iOS not built here
• Passenger ETAs agree with the driver's and the destination box no longer scrambles fast typing: "Arriving in", the Est. arrival card and the map minutes count down at the router's pace for the road left, as the driver app does, not a fixed 22 km/h (BUG-021), and the family share page uses the router's time; the driver's request cards mark the straight-line pickup distance "≈ 3.4 km" (BUG-022); the trip planner's boxes replace their text only when the app set it, never with a lagging copy of what was just typed, so the cursor no longer jumps to the start (BUG-028); Android and iOS. RideEtaTest (7), DistancesTest (3), TypedEchoesTest (4), shared-trip spec 22/22, tsc clean; passenger 69 / driver 102 unit tests. iOS not built here
• Malayalam end to end: both apps send Accept-Language and sync the account's language (BUG-083); server errors are translated in one place from common/i18n/ml-messages.ts (BUG-078, BUG-024); pushes, notification rows and socket alerts go out in the person's language from ml-notifications.ts (BUG-076); notifications the apps build and channel names follow the in-app language, with no forced English in OfferNotifier (BUG-077); services, vehicle categories and types, document types, plans and booking-form labels get Malayalam fields editable in the admin (BUG-079, BUG-025, migration 20261023110000_catalogue_malayalam); tab labels shrink to fit instead of being cut (BUG-069); Android and iOS; all Malayalam is a draft for native review (docs/malayalam-review.md). API 1786 tests, tsc clean, admin ng build; driver 103 / passenger 57 unit tests; BUG-069 and channel names checked on Phone A. iOS not built here
• Passenger booking and account: a ride can be booked only inside the service area and up to the vehicle's longest trip — districts get a centre and radius (admin Services → Availability) and vehicle types a longest trip (Auto 30 km, Car 60 km), refused with OUTSIDE_SERVICE_AREA / TRIP_TOO_LONG in the app's language and on WhatsApp, districts with no area refuse nothing (BUG-037, migration 20261023100000_service_area); emergency contacts refuse the passenger's own number (OWN_NUMBER, BUG-E08); cancelling a scheduled ride asks why first, without "Waiting too long" (BUG-E15); at a large font the bottom bar labels shrink to fit and Confirm pickup stays on screen (BUG-E03); Android and iOS. service-area, district-area and emergency-contacts specs; API 1771/1778 (7 OTP timeouts pass alone); admin ng build; passenger 56 unit tests; E03, E08 and E15 checked on Phone B. iOS not built here
• "Trip started" now reaches a passenger whose app is open in the background, like the other ride pushes (BUG-023); the passenger's "Arriving in" adds the time the driver has stood still on the way (from 2 min) and shows "Your driver hasn't moved for N min" (BUG-033); "Driver's location isn't updating" after 60 s with no driver position, and the driver's pickup and trip screens warn "Location is off — the passenger can't see you" with Turn on, following the location switch live (BUG-036); Android and iOS; ML strings need native review. push-notifier spec 11/11, tsc clean; DriverWatchTest; driver 99 / passenger 58 unit tests; BUG-033 and BUG-036 checked on Phone A + B. iOS not built here
• SOS no longer promises that emergency contacts get the passenger's live location automatically (BUG-E06): the Emergency contacts hint says Gramob calls its helpline and gets a text ready with a live trip link that the passenger taps Send to share, the SOS screen says Gramob support has your location, and the no-contacts hint says you can text them (EN and ML, Android and iOS; ML awaits native review); the server stores and returns contactsNotified 0 until an SMS gateway exists and the admin SOS list says contacts were not texted by Gramob; inventory doc updated. raise-sos.spec (6); API 1753/1756 (3 OTP timeouts in reviewer-mobile, untouched, pass alone); passenger 53 unit tests; English hint checked on Phone B. iOS not built here
• A fare from a driver who went offline can no longer be chosen — before, the passenger could pick it and the ride was assigned to the offline driver (BUG-039): going offline (the toggle, a fresh sign-in, suspension, a renewal sent back for review, plan expiry, removal from the console) takes back the driver's open fares (scheduled-ride fares stay) and tells each passenger at once; choosing a driver who is offline or no longer approved is refused with DRIVER_OFFLINE under the driver lock, the fare is withdrawn and the ride is not claimed; the offer list shows online drivers only; an offline driver cannot send a fare; a driver back online gets the request again and can re-quote; the passenger app drops that offer at once and says "That driver is no longer available" (Android and iOS, EN + ML). Tests: driver-offline.spec (9), offline-clock +2, offers-open +1; full API suite 1761/1761; passenger 53/53 unit tests. Not yet checked on phones (needs a dev deploy); iOS not built here
• Login: tapping Get OTP / Resend more than once no longer ends in "ThrottlerException: Too Many Requests" (Android and iOS, driver and passenger): a repeat code request inside the 30 s resend cooldown answers OK with the time left and texts nothing (the code already sent still works) instead of OTP_COOLDOWN; a 429 says "Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again." from the API, and the apps never show the throttler's own wording even from an older server; the driver apps ignore Get OTP and Resend taps while a request is on its way, and the iOS passenger app marks sending/resending before the request starts. The 5-per-5-minutes limit on code requests stays; version W1.3.97 / M2.0.221
